profile_before: rt-speed/rt4d-profile-profile: OriginalCharacterAIPass.draw 4.52% inclusive of the main thread, 2.64% of it OriginalStateRecord.integer for the 3000 single-byte reads; the same (0..<3000).map pattern at 14 sites
change: OriginalRandom.table(record, at:) returns record.definedBytes(offset, 3000) (one copy when all 3000 bytes are in range and defined, flat or paged) and otherwise the old per-byte map, so the first failing byte throws the same error; the 14 sites (actor control, actor hits, character AI, match continuation, mission stage, music configuration, object input, post-draw commands, lifecycle, slot prefix, war battle, world contacts, links, physics) call it instead of the map.

phone.why_small: the harness's virtual clock (8 ms per message-loop iteration) makes every tick sleep ~3.3 x 5 ms for real whatever the compute time (off-CPU profile rt4f-offcpu-profile: 99.8% of the main thread's off-CPU time in Looper::pollOnce, 1,316 of 1,785 waits 4-6 ms); compute savings show only partly in ticks per second
